answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 32925 Country: India Title: Nikah During Menstruation Period Question: Is Nikah during Menstrution period Valid, if someone perform nikah during that period what she supposed to do. plz clarify urgently Answer ID: 32925 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1022/857/B=1432) The nikah is right during menstruating period. The nikah shall be valid, but the rukhsati should be made after the menses is over. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
